verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents serving local models via an OpenAI-like REST API (lm-studio-docs-5, lm-studio-docs-9) and a CLI server mode (lm-studio-docs-12), which by OpenAI-API convention typically supports streaming responses, and community users confirm using its OpenAI-compatible server for building/testing apps (lm-studio-comm-7). However, no evidence explicitly confirms token-by-token streaming behavior or documents a stream parameter/example. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on confirmation of streaming token output, code examples showing stream=true usage, and independent verification that streaming works reliably.
